summary: A [Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034](2026-01-22-digital-economy-1bn-gdp-2034) opened its implementation year, and the base holds no dated 2025 progress position against any of its targets.
developments:
Targets were restated at an annual conference in January 2026, and the framework is held as stated intent only ([framework](2026-01-22-digital-economy-1bn-gdp-2034)).

The sector's contribution to gross domestic product carried into that restatement is a 2022/23 figure carried forward, with nothing dated 2025 or 2026 on file ([contribution](2026-01-22-digital-economy-1bn-gdp-2034)).

A ten-year framework whose headline economic measure is three years stale at its own implementation launch is the position, and it is the frame for the delivery counted below.

summary: A [National Data Management Framework](2025-08-29-tanzania-ukinara-usimamizi-data) was reported at stakeholder stage with completion targeted for January 2026, and eleven months have passed with nothing later on file.
developments:
It is positioned within a continental data policy framework ([framework](2025-08-29-tanzania-ukinara-usimamizi-data)).

Nothing has entered the base since August 2025. The country has a data protection Act in force and an active commission, so what is missing is the management layer above them rather than the protection layer itself.

summary: A [national artificial-intelligence strategy or guidelines](2026-07-30-mwananchi-maeneo-manne-wataalamu-tehama-ictc) missed a stated 2025 release, with government still drafting, and [health-data localisation and approval conditions](2026-07-31-tanzania-ai-drive-in-healthcare-amid-data-privacy-push) were asserted at a conference before any national instrument exists.
developments:
An archives officer told a training event that government is still drafting guidelines, and an external outlook the same day placed the country among states still developing strategies; the sources name guidelines and a strategy separately and the base does not establish whether they are the same object ([drafting](2026-07-30-mwananchi-maeneo-manne-wataalamu-tehama-ictc), [outlook](2026-07-30-cipit-east-african-ai-policy-outlook-report), [path](2025-07-29-tanzania-charts-path-responsible-ai)).

Health-data localisation and approval conditions for artificial intelligence were stated at a university health conference in July 2026: a sectoral permissioning claim arriving before any national instrument, with no instrument and no named approving authority, and a dedicated regulator called for from the floor rather than announced ([health](2026-07-31-tanzania-ai-drive-in-healthcare-amid-data-privacy-push)).

Sectoral permissioning asserted ahead of the national rule is how the gap is being filled in practice.

summary: A [digital trust initiative](2026-08-09-tanzania-digital-trust-forum-tppa-launch) was launched at an inaugural forum by a private-sector-founded body naming public regulators as partners.
developments:
No constitution, funding, membership list or statement of the regulators' role in it is held ([initiative](2026-08-09-tanzania-digital-trust-forum-tppa-launch), [sandbox](2026-08-08-tanzania-digital-trust-initiative-launch-sandbox)).

A private body naming regulators as partners, with no published account of what that partnership commits either side to, is worth recording as exactly that.

summary: The [Electronic Transactions Act was amended by the Finance Act 2026](2026-06-30-tanzania-finance-act-2026), and a [review of more than 1,000 laws](2026-08-12-tanzania-review-1000-laws-attract-tech-investment) was announced with no list, sequencing, responsible body or timetable.
developments:
Section 13 of the Act was amended on 30 June 2026; the land, building and motor-vehicle requirement is a substantive obligation in its own right and is not part of the scheduled transaction classes the separate order lists ([amendment](2026-06-30-tanzania-finance-act-2026)).

The thousand-law review was announced in August 2026 with nothing stated about scope, sequencing, responsible body, timetable or consultation route ([review](2026-08-12-tanzania-review-1000-laws-attract-tech-investment)).

Distinguishing the Act amendment from the order made under it matters: secondary accounts treat the mandatory-payment regime as regulations, and it is neither.

summary: The [Personal Data Protection Act, 2022](2026-02-09 Notification obligations arising from personal data breaches in Tanzania) commenced in May 2023 with regulations in force, and practitioners record that key terms remain undefined and there is no adequacy mechanism for cross-border transfers.
developments:
Practitioners record that security breach and without undue delay remain undefined, that there is no adequacy mechanism for cross-border transfers, and that there is no duty to notify data subjects ([Act](2026-02-09 Notification obligations arising from personal data breaches in Tanzania)).

Those three gaps bear directly on the rest of this unit: the identity register connects to more than 138 institutions, the social-media tax-credential rule publishes trader identifiers, and the financial consumer-protection regulations cross-reference this Act as their data basis.

summary: The commission issued a [seven-day completion ultimatum](2026-06-12-wananchi-waonywa-kutoa-taarifa-binafsi) on registration and officer duties, and launched a [certified data-protection officer programme](2026-07-14 OUT, PDPC Launch National Data Protection Programme) with the open university.
developments:
Inspections were announced to begin in April 2026 and the ultimatum followed in June; the base holds no count of registered controllers and no inspection outcome, fine or enforcement decision after that start date ([ultimatum](2026-06-12-wananchi-waonywa-kutoa-taarifa-binafsi), [inspections](2026-02-12-pdpc-to-begin-data-protection-inspections-april)).

The officer programme is the capacity answer to the statutory mandatory-officer duty, with no intake number, fee or first cohort date on file ([programme](2026-07-14 OUT, PDPC Launch National Data Protection Programme)).

An inspection regime announced, an ultimatum issued and no outcome published is the enforcement position here.

summary: [39,117 numbers were blocked](2026-08-14-tanzania-39000-numbers-blocked-fraud-tcra) for registration fraud against 56 incident reports to the police — blocking is not prosecution.
developments:
The regulator gave full-year and quarterly enforcement figures to parliament in August 2026 ([enforcement](2026-08-14-tanzania-39000-numbers-blocked-fraud-tcra), [joint response](2026-08-11-tanzania-mobile-fraud-tcra-telecoms-joint-response), [fraud](2026-07-13-nyuma-ya-pazia-utapeli-mtandaoni)).

Fifty-six incident reports stand against 39,117 numbers blocked ([figures](2026-08-14-tanzania-39000-numbers-blocked-fraud-tcra)), and no conviction or restitution figure is held. Administrative disconnection in those numbers, with prosecution three orders of magnitude below it, is the shape of enforcement rather than a gap in reporting.

summary: An influencer sued a platform company alleging government-directed account suspensions ([suit](2026-09-01-techcabal-tanzania-kimambi-sues-meta)).
developments:
An activist and social-media influencer sued a platform company in the United States, alleging her accounts were disabled at the government's direction ([suit](2026-09-01-techcabal-tanzania-kimambi-sues-meta)). The allegation is untested and the base holds no government response.

No gazetted instrument, directive or regulator order for the shutdown is held; the record is third-party monitoring only, and the monitor states its counts are subject to revision ([shutdown](2026-03-01 Rising Repression Meets Global Resistance Internet Shutdowns in 2025), [integrity](2026-03-05 Safeguarding Tanzania's information integrity), [economy](2026-06-09-tanzania-getting-online-digital-economy-igp-report)).

Licensed online content outlets fell on the regulator's quarterly count to June 2026 ([licences](2026-08-19-thecitizen-tanzania-online-content-licensing-decline)).

A civil-society study measures online gendered violence against election candidates across cycles; the base holds no regulator, electoral-commission or platform figure for the same phenomenon, so it is the only measurement on file and it is the researcher's own ([violence](2026-08-18-pollicy-cost-of-candidacy-ogbv-elections)).

summary: Somalia sent a delegation to study the labour digital systems and is seeking the wider e-governance model ([visit](2026-08-28-kazigo-tanzania-somalia-labour-digital-systems)).
developments:
A Somali government delegation studied the labour and employment digital systems in Dodoma on 28 August 2026 ([visit](2026-08-28-kazigo-tanzania-somalia-labour-digital-systems)), and Somalia is seeking to learn from the public-service digitalisation experience more broadly ([report](2026-08-31-dailynews-tanzania-somalia-egovernance-model)).

The consultations were held in February 2026; no adoption date, text or national ratification step is on file and the source is held as an excerpt ([strategy](2026-03-31 EAC moves to create unified AI Sovereignty bloc)).

The pipeline consultancy was tendered in August 2026 under a European and regional programme; the record is a procurement notice, so it fixes the consultancy stage and nothing about any project it may prepare ([pipeline](2026-08-05-eac-dpi-consulting-ostafrika-giz-bmz-tender)).

The country is consulting on a regional artificial-intelligence strategy while its own has missed its release date.

summary: A [twenty-year Zanzibar broadband agreement](2026-06-25-yas-zictia-expand-broadband-zanzibar) was signed, ten months after the [same agency signed an unpriced memorandum](2025-08-19-airtel-tanzania-zictia-broadband-zanzibar) with another operator that produced nothing on file.
developments:
Nothing is on record being built under the twenty-year agreement and no first-phase start date is held ([agreement](2026-06-25-yas-zictia-expand-broadband-zanzibar), [memorandum](2025-08-19-airtel-tanzania-zictia-broadband-zanzibar)).

The earlier memorandum covered broadband, digital inclusion and public services and produced nothing on file ([earlier](2025-08-19-airtel-tanzania-zictia-broadband-zanzibar)).

One agency, two operators, one priced and one not, and no build under either — which is why the priced agreement is recorded as planned rather than as delivery.

summary: The [communications vote fell 24 per cent year on year](2026-04-30-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2026-27), and the whole reduction is external finance — domestic development finance is unchanged.
developments:
Estimates were presented to Parliament in April 2026 ([estimates](2026-04-30-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2026-27), [vote](2026-04-30-tza-2026-68), [forward](2026-04-30-tza-2027-68)).

That the entire fall sits in external finance while the domestic line holds is the finding, and it is the opposite of the pattern most units in this frame show, where the domestic share shrinks.

summary: A [US$150m digital project](2021-05-27-wb-tza-001-digital-tanzania-project) scheduled to close in 2026 has no closure, disbursement figure or completion report on file, and a [US$170m concessional loan](2026-08-23-moef-korea-edcf-159th-committee-tanzania-ai-institute) was approved for an artificial-intelligence training institute.
developments:
The digital project was board-approved in 2021 covering broadband, digital government, digital financial services and digital skills. It is the largest single commitment in the base and nothing marks its closure ([project](2021-05-27-wb-tza-001-digital-tanzania-project)).

The loan was approved at a lender's 159th management committee in August 2026; it is an approval rather than a signature or a disbursement, and no site, intake, curriculum or completion date is stated ([approval](2026-08-23-moef-korea-edcf-159th-committee-tanzania-ai-institute), [loan](2026-08-25-south-korea-loan-ai-digital-training-tanzania), [committee](2026-08-23-edcf-tza-ai-digital-training-institute-2026-tanzania-ai-institute)).

The lender's own press release is in the base and is not citable, so the approval reaches this report through secondary accounts.

summary: A [US$25m credit facility extendable to US$50m](2026-05-29-nala-raises-50m-payment-rails) was announced for payment rails, and [startups raising disclosed funding](2026-02-03-disrupt-africa-african-tech-startups-funding-report-2025) fell on an annual tracker.
developments:
The facility is debt rather than equity; the base's prior record for the same company is a different instrument, and no local-currency figure is published ([facility](2026-05-29-nala-raises-50m-payment-rails)).

The startup count comes from a third-party tracker of disclosed rounds only, with both ends from the same report ([startups](2026-02-03-disrupt-africa-african-tech-startups-funding-report-2025)).

The leading operator reported network investment and coverage at its annual general meeting; those are the operator's own figures, not a regulator series ([operator](2026-08-21-tra-vodacom-tanzania-10th-agm)).

summary: [Three bilateral cooperation tracks](2026-07-17-tza-brazil-poland-wsis-mous) were opened in one week with no signed instrument, and a [digital economy memorandum](2026-07-24-tanzania-huawei-mou-uchumi-wa-kidijitali-na-ubunifu) was signed with a Chinese vendor.
developments:
Cooperation frameworks with three states were agreed at an international summit, memoranda proposed and none signed; no signed instrument, amount or timetable is held for any of the three ([tracks](2026-07-17-tza-brazil-poland-wsis-mous), [frontier](2026-07-20-tza-russia-tech-frontier)).

The vendor memorandum was signed in Shanghai by the ministry's permanent secretary and witnessed by the minister; no commitment amount, term or financing structure is stated in the ministry's own release, and device manufacture is placed inside a vendor memorandum rather than an industrial policy ([memorandum](2026-07-24-tanzania-huawei-mou-uchumi-wa-kidijitali-na-ubunifu)).

Putting domestic device manufacture inside a supplier agreement rather than a policy instrument is the substantive point.

progress: Mixed, fifth-generation facilities up 139 per cent while the smartphone user count fell quarter on quarter
summary: [Fifth-generation facilities rose 139 per cent](2026-06-18-nationwide-5g-rollout-gains-momentum) from 754 in June 2024 with data consumption up from 426 to 932 petabytes, while the [smartphone user count fell](2026-06-10-telecom-infrastructure-5g-expansion-low-smartphone) quarter on quarter as the percentage rose.
developments:
The regulator's quarterly report to March 2026 carries the facilities and consumption figures ([deployment](2026-06-18-nationwide-5g-rollout-gains-momentum), [expansion](2026-06-10-telecom-infrastructure-5g-expansion-low-smartphone)).

The smartphone user count fell quarter on quarter while the percentage rose and the base does not reconcile the two; the regulator names low smartphone penetration and a 23.7 per cent geographic broadband gap as sector challenges ([smartphones](2026-06-10-telecom-infrastructure-5g-expansion-low-smartphone)).

Active subscriptions and penetration come from the regulator's own quarterly report for the quarter to June 2026, now held first-hand ([subscriptions](2026-08-10-tcra-communications-sector-performance-report-quarter-ending-june-2026), [report](2026-08-17-dailynews-tanzania-tcra-communications-sector-report-june-2026), [regional](2026-08-03-eaco-regional-communications-sector-statistics-report-2025)).

summary: The prime minister committed to further national backbone investment and higher rural fund allocations ([statement](2026-08-27-ippmedia-tanzania-rural-telecom-pm-statement)).
developments:
The prime minister committed to continued investment in the communications sector, including strengthening the national backbone and raising funding for the rural communications fund ([statement](2026-08-27-ippmedia-tanzania-rural-telecom-pm-statement)). No amount or route length is stated.

A contradiction between three figures is resolved: 16,280 km is the planned total, 13,820 km the length laid at April 2025, and 15,167 km the length at December 2025 ([backbone](2026-05-13-tz-minister-statement-wtisd-2026)); the "over 15,000 km" quoted at an international summit in July 2026 is that December figure, correctly stated ([backbone](2026-05-13-tz-minister-statement-wtisd-2026), [budget](2025-05-16-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2025-26), [zanzibar](2026-08-24-tanzania-mwinyi-ttcl-zanzibar-connectivity), [sector](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc)).

It is built as a state network: the regional manager states phase one connected government offices and public institutions, with individual citizens only next. A backbone user figure for one region was given to the minister and no national connected-user total is held ([users](2026-07-24-mwananchi-kairuki-mkongo-wa-taifa-dodoma)).

A cross-border terrestrial link was launched in July 2026 with no capacity, cost or financing stated, and its relation to a 2025 connection is unreconciled ([link](2026-07-29-kenya-and-tanzania-launch-terrestrial-fiber-link-connection)).

summary: A [submarine cable](2025-11-12-tanzania-kilimanjaro-one-submarine-cable) was announced in November 2025 with no construction start, contractor or cost confirmed since, and [cables and landing stations](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc) are counted on two unreconciled bases.
developments:
The cable announcement has produced nothing further in the base ([cable](2025-11-12-tanzania-kilimanjaro-one-submarine-cable)).

Cables and landing stations are not the same unit and nothing in the base reconciles the two counts, one from the regulator to December 2025 and one from a ministerial statement at an international summit ([cables](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc), [summit](2026-07-24-tanzania-mafanikio-akili-unde-ai-waico-2026-shanghai)).

summary: The state operator [reset its fibre-to-the-home target to 2028](2026-05-06-ttcl-targets-1-million-fiber-subscribers-2028) with about 200,000 of 280,000 financial-year connections delivered, and a [second operator launched fibre service](2026-08-20-tan-yas-tanzania-fibre-dodoma) in the capital.
developments:
The target slipped to 2028 with roughly seven-tenths of the year's connections delivered; the event date is not stated so the publication date stands, and subscriber ranks are regulator data to end-March 2026 ([target](2026-05-06-ttcl-targets-1-million-fiber-subscribers-2028)).

A second operator launched fibre-to-the-home and business service in the capital in August 2026 ([launch](2026-08-20-tan-yas-tanzania-fibre-dodoma)).

summary: [Satellite broadband went live](2026-01-01 Starlink Partners with Airtel & Vodacom From Rival to Ally) in November 2025 through operator partnerships, and no subscriber, licence or pricing figure for the country is held.
developments:
The service went live at month precision, with the satellite operator moving from rival to partner of two mobile operators ([service](2026-01-01 Starlink Partners with Airtel & Vodacom From Rival to Ally), [partnership](2025-05-06-airtel-spacex-starlink-afrika)).

No subscriber, licence or pricing figure is held. Arriving through operator partnerships rather than a direct consumer licence is a different market structure from most units in this frame, and no licensing instrument is on file either way.

summary: A [758-tower rural project](2026-08-15-tanzania-758-towers-world-bank-ucsaf-connectivity) reported progress to Parliament with no count completed against the plan, [758 towers were handed to government](2026-04-11-yas-tanzania-hand-over-758-towers), and [133 universal-service sites](2026-04-13 Helios Towers completes 133 UCSAF sites to expand rural connectivity in Tanzania) were completed.
developments:
The tower project's figures are the ministry's own, with no count of towers completed against the 758 planned and no measure of service uptake in the connected villages ([project](2026-08-15-tanzania-758-towers-world-bank-ucsaf-connectivity)).

An operator handed 758 towers and fibre to government in April 2026 ([handover](2026-04-11-yas-tanzania-hand-over-758-towers), [sector](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc)), and a further 636-mast programme is due in March 2027 with no cost, financier or completion date stated ([masts](2026-07-24-mwananchi-kairuki-mkongo-wa-taifa-dodoma)).

The universal service fund completed 133 sites; no levy rate, fund balance, appropriation or programme-wide site target is held anywhere in the base, so the fund is named and never quantified ([fund](2026-04-13 Helios Towers completes 133 UCSAF sites to expand rural connectivity in Tanzania)).

summary: A [commercial data-centre estate](2026-08-05-world-bank-tanzania-digital-dividend) is counted in a sector review, a [tier-three facility hosting the national internet exchange](2026-04-30-wingu-africa-targets-tanzania-regional-digital-hub) has had no update in seventeen months, and a [local cloud exchange platform](2026-04-23-wingu-cloud-exchange-tanzania-lodge-interview) launched here first.
developments:
The commercial count is a trade-magazine count rather than a regulator's, and it sits alongside a separate count of public centres which is the state's own and is not the same measure ([estate](2026-08-05-world-bank-tanzania-digital-dividend)).

The tier-three facility's second phase launched in March 2025 and hosts the national internet exchange to keep domestic traffic local; seventeen months with no update is the finding ([facility](2026-04-30-wingu-africa-targets-tanzania-regional-digital-hub), [phase](2025-03-19 Tanzania's digital shift gathers pace with $50 million data centre)).

A cloud exchange platform launched here as its first market in November 2025 at month precision ([exchange](2026-04-23-wingu-cloud-exchange-tanzania-lodge-interview)), and a further site is named at group level on a funding item tagged to seven places with no local site, size, cost or date given ([site](2026-07-15 Raxio data-centre capital tops $380m on investor boost)).

summary: [Three public data centres were commissioned](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc) between March 2021 and December 2025 with no rack, floor-space or power capacity published, and [national centres at two sites](2026-06-19-liquid-tanzania-government-align-digital-transformation) are named as active investment.
developments:
No rack, floor-space or power capacity is published for any of the four, so the state's own estate cannot be sized ([commissioned](2026-04-10-communications-sector-surges-400pc)).

The two national centres are named as active government investment with no commissioning date, capacity or completion percentage held for either ([centres](2026-06-19-liquid-tanzania-government-align-digital-transformation), [allocation](2025-05-16-tanzania-allocates-sh73-billion-ict-backbone), [budget](2026-04-30-kairuki-aomba-222-bilioni-bajeti-micit)).

A national artificial-intelligence data centre is stated by the minister to be under construction, and the power claim attached to it is the one sovereignty argument in this unit with a physical constraint behind it ([AI centre](2026-07-24-tanzania-mafanikio-akili-unde-ai-waico-2026-shanghai)).

summary: A [cyber-skills partnership](2025-08-17-tanzania-kuongeza-wataalamu-wadukuzi-mtandaoni) announced in August 2025 has produced nothing further in twelve months, and [practical backbone training](2026-07-23-ttcl-dit-nictbb-training) with a technical institute has no intake number or cadence published.
developments:
Twelve months with nothing further on file is the finding for the cyber-skills partnership ([partnership](2025-08-17-tanzania-kuongeza-wataalamu-wadukuzi-mtandaoni)).

The backbone training was reported in July 2026 with the visit date not stated, and no intake number, cadence or programme name is published ([training](2026-07-23-ttcl-dit-nictbb-training)).

A state backbone of the length recorded elsewhere in this report, and two training arrangements with no measured throughput, is the maintenance capacity the record supports.

summary: Enforcement was tightened on a [government asset management information system](2026-08-09-tanzania-gamis-public-asset-management-system), with no count of assets recorded, entities complying or value reconciled published.
developments:
The tightening was reported in August 2026, and the two named investments are cited as scale rather than as entries in the system ([system](2026-08-09-tanzania-gamis-public-asset-management-system)).

An asset register whose own contents are unpublished cannot evidence the control it is meant to provide, which is the same gap the identity, tower and data-centre counts show in this unit.

summary: Registration of [critical ICT infrastructure](2026-08-19-dailynews-tanzania-critical-ict-infrastructure-vigilance) was directed by the minister with no designation criteria, deadline or register size published, and [cybercrime investigation centres](2026-08-19-tanzania-dira2050-security-digital-identity) are provided for in the home affairs budget.
developments:
The registration direction was given in August 2026 ([register](2026-08-19-dailynews-tanzania-critical-ict-infrastructure-vigilance)), and the investigation centres were stated to Parliament with the 2026/27 budget with no cost line, timetable or staffing figure ([centres](2026-08-19-tanzania-dira2050-security-digital-identity)).

An international cybersecurity index placement is cited and not absorbed, with the underlying edition and its date not established ([index](2025-04-11-kuelekea-uchumi-kidijitali-usalama-mtandaoni)).

A national cybersecurity forum held a fourth edition in April 2025 with no 2026 edition recorded ([forum](2025-04-10-experts-back-tanzania-cyber-security-push)), and a Zanzibar cybersecurity capacity memorandum was signed with no value, term or deliverable named and the signing date not distinguished from the publication date ([memorandum](2026-06-11-zanzibar-wizara-yawekeza-usalama-mtandao)).

progress: Mixed, a service bus credited with a top-tier maturity classification while no source states how many institutions actually joined
summary: A [government enterprise service bus](2026-01-26 Tanzania's GovTech success raises bar for East Africa's digital states) was named by an external maturity index as the backbone underpinning a top-tier classification, and no held source states how many institutions joined by the deadline.
developments:
The index named it as the backbone of the classification; the release date is month-precision and no held source states the actual onboarding count ([bus](2026-01-26 Tanzania's GovTech success raises bar for East Africa's digital states), [deadline](2025-06-23-majaliwa-taasisi-umma-kujiunga-govesb)).

A separate exchange platform is a distinct build from the service bus and is routinely conflated with it in secondary accounts; the ICT minister said in 2024 the ministry was still coordinating its construction ([exchange](2024-10-18-hakikisheni-mnapata-namba-ya-nida-jamii-namba-majaliwa), [systems](2024-08-27-mfumo-jamii-x-change-kuunganisha-mifumo-tehama)).

Public institutions connected under the digital economy framework are counted to December 2025; that is a network-connection count and must not be read as a service-bus onboarding count ([connections](2026-01-22-digital-economy-1bn-gdp-2034)).

summary: The identity register's database reaches [more than 138 connected institutions](2026-07-28-tanzania-financial-inclusion-expands-usage-gap-next-challenge) — the hardest adoption figure the base holds for any African identity-verification rail.
developments:
The count comes from an annual financial-inclusion report ([integrations](2026-07-28-tanzania-financial-inclusion-expands-usage-gap-next-challenge), [numbers](2025-04-14-nida-kutoa-namba-watoto-wageni-jamii-namba)).

It is the hardest adoption figure this base holds for any African identity-verification rail, which is a claim about the corpus and is stated as one.

What it does not establish is query volume, uptime or the lawful basis for any individual integration, and the data protection Act it operates under has no adequacy mechanism for transfers and no duty to notify data subjects.

summary: Digital acquisition of identification numbers and cards is under development, aimed at rural access ([report](2026-08-27-dailynews-tanzania-nida-digital-rural-access)).
developments:
Measures are under development to let citizens obtain identification numbers and cards digitally, aimed at rural access ([report](2026-08-27-dailynews-tanzania-nida-digital-rural-access)). The base holds no enrolment figure against it.

The coverage figures run to December 2025 in an annual financial-inclusion report ([coverage](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025), [usage](2026-07-28-tanzania-financial-inclusion-expands-usage-gap-next-challenge)).

Issuance and distribution are stated separately in the same report; the bases differ between personalised, issued and distributed, both counts rose and the gap did not close ([issuance](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

At the window's start the base held only a deadline to deactivate the numbers of people who never collected cards, with no count ([uncollected](2026-01-04 Tanzania rolls out infant registration for stronger citizen ID)). A one-year window opened for more than 14,000 dismissed public servants to correct records and obtain cards, closing inside the next reporting year ([window](2025-11-27-waliofukuzwa-vyeti-feki-kupata-nida)).

summary: The authority [published tenders for iris and facial recognition contractors](2026-04-22 Tanzania seeks biometrics contractors for Phase II of national digital ID project) for a second expansion phase, and [identity card printing stays centralised](2026-05-22-national-ids-stay-under-centralised-printing) after a request to print in Zanzibar was declined on security grounds.
developments:
Two independent parliamentary accounts agree on the expansion's scope ([tenders](2026-04-22 Tanzania seeks biometrics contractors for Phase II of national digital ID project), [expansion](2026-04-18-nida-executes-national-id-expansion-project-ii)).

The government declined a request to print identity cards in Zanzibar on security grounds; passports are printed there and identity cards are not ([printing](2026-05-22-national-ids-stay-under-centralised-printing)).

A free short-code service was launched for checking identity status by message ([status](2025-12-29-nida-yazindua-namba-ya-bure-sms)). Adding iris and face to a register already connected to more than 138 institutions is an expansion of what can be matched, and no data-protection assessment for it is on file.

progress: Mixed, a from-birth registration pilot running about six months ahead of the bill that would enable it
summary: [Registration from birth is in pilot](2026-08-20-tanzania-pushes-crvs-id-integration-as-birth-registration-becomes-a-dpi-layer) with under-fives linked to the mother's identity because no biometric solution works for them, and the pilot ran about six months ahead of its [enabling bill](2026-01-06-tanzania-legislative-framework-infant-id-registration).
developments:
The registration agency and identity authority are linking to issue the identifier from birth; under-fives are linked to the mother's identity, and as at August 2026 the minister reports over 22 million people holding a national identification number as of April 2026 and describes the two agencies' integration as the route by which the identifier is issued from birth, with no integration milestone, date or technical description accompanying it ([pilot](2026-08-20-tanzania-pushes-crvs-id-integration-as-birth-registration-becomes-a-dpi-layer), [children](2026-05-25-nida-kuanza-kusajili-watoto-jamii-namba), [rollout](2026-05-09-jamii-namba-children-pilot-set-for-rollout)).

The enabling bill was set for a session opening in January 2026 and was not tabled; one source's headline says the scheme rolls out where its body says only that government is preparing to table, and the body governs ([bill](2026-01-06-tanzania-legislative-framework-infant-id-registration), [registration](2026-01-04 Tanzania rolls out infant registration for stronger citizen ID)).

The identifier as a distinct issued credential was named a 2026/27 budget priority, having been declared design-complete in March 2024 with an end-2025 conclusion target ([identifier](2026-08-19-tanzania-dira2050-security-digital-identity), [design](2024-03-12-jamii-namba-development-work-started-chanzo)).

summary: The central bank's [sandbox reviewed 35 applications and approved five](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025) for live testing, launched a [sovereign yield curve system](2026-08-07-tanzania-bot-sovereign-yield-curve-system), and a [digital currency remains under study](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025).
developments:
The sandbox throughput comes from an annual report; the sandbox existed earlier but no earlier throughput figures are held ([sandbox](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

The yield curve system was launched in August 2026, with the investor counts the governor's own given at the launch ([yield curve](2026-08-07-tanzania-bot-sovereign-yield-curve-system)).

A central bank digital currency remains under study with no design, pilot or timetable in any held source ([currency](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)), and a national code payment standard had 27 participating providers at end-2025 ([standard](2026-06-02-bot-national-payment-system-annual-report-2025)).

summary: [Instant payment value nearly doubled](2026-07-30-thecitizen-tz-cash-lite-drive-digital-payments) year on year on calendar-2025 volumes reported to Parliament, and a [US$28m mobile money core upgrade](2026-04-03-vodacom-tanzania-mpesa-fintech-2-platform) added interoperability with a global payment provider.
developments:
The throughput figures were reported in the 2026/27 budget; a third figure on a different basis is held and cannot be charted with these ([throughput](2026-07-30-thecitizen-tz-cash-lite-drive-digital-payments), [platform](2025-05-16 Building an Inclusive Payments Ecosystem in Tanzania through TIPS (BOT and FSDT))).

The core upgrade launched in 2026 with wallet interoperability to a global payment provider added in May ([upgrade](2026-04-03-vodacom-tanzania-mpesa-fintech-2-platform), [alliance](2026-05-26-vodacom-mpesa-tanzania-paypal-alliance)).

A school-fee payment service connected more than 800 schools ([schools](2026-08-21-tan-airtel-money-school-pay-tanzania)), a wallet-based investment platform recorded more than TZS 370bn in customer investments to March 2026 on the operator's own results ([investing](2026-07-31-vodacom-lesotho-brings-micro-investing-to-m-pesa)), and a government payments programme was described by a ministry official as still to be created ([programme](2024-08-27-mfumo-jamii-x-change-kuunganisha-mifumo-tehama)).

2026-08-30 — the state operator and the Zanzibar Football Federation [signed a sponsorship and partnership agreement to introduce stadium e-ticketing on the operator's N-Card platform](2026-08-31-techafricanews-ttcl-zff-nfc-ticketing). No launch date, ticket volume or fee is stated, and the base holds nothing on the platform's other uses or acceptance footprint.

summary: [All 47 participating providers](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025) are connected, [113 payment service providers are licensed](2026-04-28-interoperability-costs-cut-113-agencies) with the central bank described as licensing aggressively to break monopolies, and [merchants accepting digital payments](2026-06-02-bot-national-payment-system-annual-report-2025) rose.
developments:
All 47 participants are connected on the annual report's count, with no earlier participant count held ([participants](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

The finance minister told Parliament 113 providers were licensed, with the central bank described as licensing aggressively to break monopolies and no earlier count held ([licensed](2026-04-28-interoperability-costs-cut-113-agencies)).

Merchant acceptance comes from the central bank's national payment systems annual report for 2025 ([merchants](2026-06-02-bot-national-payment-system-annual-report-2025), [cashless](2026-08-04-cashless-shift-poised-to-transform-economy)), and a credit reference data system was developed and deployed with onboarding under way — extended by regulation rather than by architecture, and its data subjects are borrowers ([credit](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

summary: Active mobile money subscriptions reached 87.05 million in June 2026 ([report](2026-09-01-thecitizen-tanzania-mobile-money-cashless)).
developments:
Active mobile money subscriptions reached 87.05 million in June 2026, as the country pressed a cashless agenda ([report](2026-09-01-thecitizen-tanzania-mobile-money-cashless)). A bank and the stock exchange launched digital share trading through the bank's own channel ([launch](2026-08-26-dailynews-tanzania-nbc-dse-digital-share-trading)).

The series is flattening and the regulator's own report draws that conclusion ([index](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025), [usage gap](2026-07-28-tanzania-financial-inclusion-expands-usage-gap-next-challenge)).

Active mobile-money accounts and the annual transaction count are on different bases and the stated growth rate does not reconcile against the earlier one ([accounts](2026-07-28-tanzania-financial-inclusion-expands-usage-gap-next-challenge)).

Financial access points grew through agent build-out rather than branch build-out, and the council says so itself ([access points](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)). A third national inclusion framework was reported on for 2025, with the base holding no framework position at the window's start, no text and no mid-term review ([framework](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

summary: A [mandatory electronic payments order](2026-06-30-tanzania-gn-158c-mandatory-electronic-payments-order) made nine scheduled transaction classes electronic-payment-only, an order under the electronic transactions Act rather than regulations, and cash remains legal tender.
developments:
The order came into operation in 2026 and is widely mis-reported as regulations ([order](2026-06-30-tanzania-gn-158c-mandatory-electronic-payments-order), [drive](2026-07-30-thecitizen-tz-cash-lite-drive-digital-payments)).

Mandatory electronic settlement for named transactions was explained to traders under the 2026/27 tax law changes; traders at the same meeting asked for cheaper electronic transaction charges, and no commencement date or penalty is stated in the record held ([settlement](2026-08-19-nipashe-tra-wafanyabiashara-gharama-miamala-kielektroniki)).

A central electronic ticketing system carries transport ministry figures to March 2026 alongside a companion vehicle tracking system on 13,843 buses ([ticketing](2026-08-04-cashless-shift-poised-to-transform-economy)); the figures are the ministry's, reported at second hand, and no earlier count is held for either ([ticketing](2026-08-04-cashless-shift-poised-to-transform-economy)).

Zanzibar moved a fare box and a set of municipal charges onto one wallet: fares on the fifteen electric buses that entered service on 1 August 2026 are paid by smart card, and the same platform carries municipal parking fees, traffic fines and state payments to clove farmers ([Zanzibar](2026-08-27-thecitizen-tz-zanzibar-digital-payments)).

progress: Mixed, per-instrument fee caps set and a general cap rejected while the regulations tighten complaint deadlines
summary: [Per-instrument fee caps](2026-07-31-tanzania-makato-kikwazo-kuelekea-malipo-ya-kidijitali) were set with card-scheme negotiations moving the card fee from payer to merchant, and the governor [rejected a general price cap](2026-07-31-tanzania-makato-kikwazo-kuelekea-malipo-ya-kidijitali) saying competition will cut fees within six months.
developments:
The caps are per-instrument rather than a general tariff ([caps](2026-07-31-tanzania-makato-kikwazo-kuelekea-malipo-ya-kidijitali), [interoperability](2026-04-28-interoperability-costs-cut-113-agencies)).

The general cap was rejected on the ground that charges are already low; an analyst put the worked cost at about TZS 3,500 per TZS 100,000 paid and argued the mandate manufactures avoidance ([rejection](2026-07-31-tanzania-makato-kikwazo-kuelekea-malipo-ya-kidijitali)).

Financial consumer protection amendment regulations moved the dormant-account period from five to twelve months, set complaint maxima of twelve hours for mobile money and fourteen days for credit, and fines of TZS 1m a day; the data-protection cross-reference is what wires the payments regime into the data regime ([regulations](2025-06-27 Key Highlights of the Bank of Tanzania Financial Consumer Protection Amendment Regulations GN 298 of 2025)).

summary: The cross-border instant payment proof of concept with Rwanda gained a joint cybersecurity and interoperability roadmap ([mission](2026-08-29-eac-rwanda-tanzania-cybersecurity-instant-payments)).
developments:
A joint cybersecurity and interoperability roadmap for the cross-border instant payment proof of concept with Rwanda was advanced at a technical mission in Kigali ([mission](2026-08-29-eac-rwanda-tanzania-cybersecurity-instant-payments)). It remains a proof of concept; nothing on the base records a live corridor.

The corridor's technical meeting ran over five days in July 2026 ([corridor](2026-07-10-eac-tanzania-rwanda-cross-border-payments)).

The card acceptance extension covers nine markets, with nearly 900 participating merchants and about 7 million cards issued in Africa given as the two companies' own figures and no country-specific count ([acceptance](2026-08-19-tan-unionpay-standard-bank-nine-african-markets), [expansion](2026-08-19-standard-bank-expands-unionpay-acceptance)).

summary: [Digital crop payments to farmers](2026-08-10-tanzania-mixx-lindi-mtwara-farmers-incomes) were reported by season at a national agricultural exhibition, all figures the operator's own.
developments:
The figures were given at a promotional exhibition at which the operator also awarded vehicles and phones to loyal users; no farmer total, fee schedule or default rate on the linked credit is published ([payments](2026-08-10-tanzania-mixx-lindi-mtwara-farmers-incomes), [northern](2026-08-08-tanzania-mixx-northern-farmers-financial-inclusion), [southern](2026-08-08-tanzania-mixx-yas-southern-highlands-farmers)).

Crop payment digitisation is the largest routine government-to-person flow in an agricultural economy, and the only account of it comes from the company that carries it.

summary: A [tax identifier display duty for online traders](2026-06-30-tanzania-gn-158g-tax-administration-general-amendment-regulations-2026) was made by the finance minister, and [named creators and traders object](2026-08-12-tanzania-social-media-tax-display-privacy-fears) that publishing the credential exposes them to impersonation.
developments:
The instrument is now held and settles three things secondary accounts left open: it was made by the Minister for Finance rather than the revenue authority, it amends regulation 58 of the 2016 regulations, and the display duty is the whole of the new sub-regulation, with no penalty provision and no non-resident provision attached ([regulations](2026-06-30-tanzania-gn-158g-tax-administration-general-amendment-regulations-2026), [display](2026-08-16-theeastafrican-tanzania-online-businesses-tax-ids)).

The objections are those of named creators and traders reported by the paper, not a regulator finding; the instrument carries no penalty provision and says nothing about how a published credential is to be protected from the impersonation the objectors describe ([objections](2026-08-12-tanzania-social-media-tax-display-privacy-fears)).

Mandatory electronic invoicing reaches the base through a regional comparative account, and the order held is the mandatory payments order of the same date with no separate invoicing instrument held ([invoicing](2026-08-19-horn-uganda-kenya-electronic-invoicing-divergence)). A Zanzibar electronic receipt mandate had its penalty band cut, the authority's own account of non-collection being the stated reason ([receipts](2026-08-21-thecitizen-zanzibar-e-receipt-fines-reduced)).

progress: Mixed, birth registration rising on estimates the base cannot reconcile to one series
summary: [Under-five birth registration](2026-08-20-tanzania-pushes-crvs-id-integration-as-birth-registration-becomes-a-dpi-layer) is quoted at 65 per cent and 68 per cent a week apart by the same minister, which is the clearest demonstration that the figure is quoted rather than published.
developments:
The base holds several differently-based estimates and does not reconcile them to one series; the two newest are a week apart from the same minister ([coverage](2026-08-20-tanzania-pushes-crvs-id-integration-as-birth-registration-becomes-a-dpi-layer), [partner](2026-06-23-unicef-partner-birth-registration-legal-identity), [framework](2026-01-06-tanzania-legislative-framework-infant-id-registration), [foundation](2026-08-13-birth-registration-emerges-as-foundation-for-digital-public-infrastructure)).

An upgraded platform reports issuing birth certificates within 48 hours, and the government has stated an intention to integrate the identity and registration agencies ([certificates](2026-01-06-tanzania-legislative-framework-infant-id-registration)).

A national partner was sought for a birth registration programme running August 2026 to August 2027, starting inside the next reporting month ([programme](2026-06-23-unicef-partner-birth-registration-legal-identity)).

summary: [Twelve million housing addresses](2026-02-09 Tanzania registers 12 million housing addresses to boost digital governance) were registered alongside a continental postal certification, and a [Zanzibar address programme](2025-08-19-tanzania-digital-id-address-student-loans-zanzibar) has assigned more than 450,000 digital addresses.
developments:
The base holds that the population rate and the address count are not derivable from one another and must not be charted together ([addresses](2026-02-09 Tanzania registers 12 million housing addresses to boost digital governance), [registration](2024-07-10 Tanzania ramps up national physical address registration)).

The Zanzibar programme has been operational since June 2025 with more than 450,000 digital addresses assigned ([zanzibar](2025-08-19-tanzania-digital-id-address-student-loans-zanzibar)); twelve months with no update is itself the finding, and the first payoff was student finance ([zanzibar](2025-08-19-tanzania-digital-id-address-student-loans-zanzibar)).

An addressing system whose first evidenced use is disbursing student loans is a useful thing to be able to say about what an address register is for.

summary: A [Zanzibar dynamic social registry](2026-08-01-deep-opm-zanzibar-dynamic-social-registry-briefing) reached a briefing on what establishment would require — research commissioned to specify a registry rather than a decision to build one.
developments:
The briefing was held in August 2026, on a blueprint prepared the previous year ([briefing](2026-08-01-deep-opm-zanzibar-dynamic-social-registry-briefing), [blueprint](2025-08-01-deep-zanzibar-dynamic-social-registry-blueprint)).

No custodian, budget, data-protection arrangement or timetable is stated. Distinguishing commissioned research from a build decision is the whole of what this cell can honestly record.

summary: The electronic government agency gave a [registered-society count](2026-08-04-ega-tanzania-digital-farming-cooperatives) for a cooperative management system at an agricultural exhibition.
developments:
No spend, timeline or denominator is given, so the count stands unbenchmarked ([system](2026-08-04-ega-tanzania-digital-farming-cooperatives)).

A registry count with no denominator cannot show coverage, and the exhibition at which it was given is the same venue at which the crop payment figures and the university prototypes were presented.

summary: Electronic records, interoperable systems and artificial intelligence entered the health sector's procurement agenda ([report](2026-09-01-thecitizen-tanzania-digital-health-procurement)).
developments:
Electronic medical records, interoperable health systems and artificial intelligence entered the sector's procurement agenda ([report](2026-09-01-thecitizen-tanzania-digital-health-procurement)), alongside a bilateral exploration of artificial intelligence and hospital information systems with South Korea ([report](2026-09-01-thecitizen-tanzania-korea-ai-healthcare)).

The functionality reading is a cross-sectional study run between November 2022 and July 2024, and a flow-share figure three years older is not restated by it ([assessment](2025-12-01-impulse-erhis-newborn-data-functionalities), [analysis](2023-10-30 A political economy analysis of strengthening health information system in Tanzania)).

The cardiac institute reported its tracking system in use for medical-camp follow-up; it is at a single specialist institute and institution-reported ([institute](2026-07-16-jkci-digital-patient-tracking-system)).

Naming the one working deployment as such, at one institute, is more useful than a general claim about health artificial intelligence that the record would not support.

summary: A [procurement complaints and appeals module](2026-08-20-dailynews-tanzania-nest-procurement-30-system-integrations) reported more than 30 system integrations, and the authority plans to [integrate it with the judiciary system](2026-07-31-tanzania-ppaa-online-appeals-nest-public-tenders) so an appeal moves without re-filing.
developments:
The integration count was reported in August 2026 with no case volumes, decision-time figures or list of the integrated systems published ([module](2026-08-20-dailynews-tanzania-nest-procurement-30-system-integrations), [appeals](2026-07-31-tanzania-ppaa-online-appeals-nest-public-tenders)).

The judiciary integration is an administrative-to-judicial data handover, so a procurement appeal moves without re-filing ([judiciary](2026-07-31-tanzania-ppaa-online-appeals-nest-public-tenders)).

A digital legal assistant recorded a disbursement for the 2025 activity year; it is a commitment record rather than a service report, with no user count, case volume or outcome stated ([assistant](2025-01-01-iati-xm-dac-21-1-2025000408b1tanpsd-dada-wakili-digital-legal-assistant-tanzania)).

summary: The three-year precision livestock farming project closed, with no successor recorded ([report](2026-08-28-thecitizen-tanzania-smart-livestock-farmers)).
developments:
A three-year precision livestock farming project, run by a national research institution with a foreign university and foundation funding, closed on 27 August 2026 and presented its results ([report](2026-08-28-thecitizen-tanzania-smart-livestock-farmers)). Nothing on the base records the work continuing under national funding.

Both systems were described at the exhibition ([systems](2026-08-04-ega-tanzania-digital-farming-cooperatives)).

No user counts, spend or timeline are given. They are the only agricultural data systems in this ledger, and they reach the base through the same exhibition as the cooperative count and the crop payments.

summary: A [maturity classification](2026-01-26 Tanzania's GovTech success raises bar for East Africa's digital states) placed the country in the top group in its 2025 edition, and the rank is not stated in any held source.
developments:
The classification's release date is month-precision and the 2025 rank is not stated in any held source; digital citizen engagement is the weak pillar region-wide ([classification](2026-01-26 Tanzania's GovTech success raises bar for East Africa's digital states), [leaders](2026-01-13-tanzania-joins-global-leaders-digital-government)).

The classification rests on the service bus recorded separately, whose actual onboarding count no source states. A top-tier placement resting on an unmeasured backbone is what the record supports.

The cereals regulator ran the country's first white maize auction on a digital trading system, selling 335,238 kilogrammes in Rukwa Region in a first phase with the mercantile exchange, the warehouse receipts board and the cooperative development commission joining the sale ([auction](2026-08-27-thecitizen-tz-digital-maize-auction)); further phases are unannounced.

summary: A [constituency digitalisation programme](2026-08-04-bayport-donates-100m-tech-facility-to-kibambas-education-department) was launched at an equipment handover, announced by the ICT minister in the constituency she represents.
developments:
No funding is disclosed for any phase beyond the donated equipment ([programme](2026-08-04-bayport-donates-100m-tech-facility-to-kibambas-education-department)).

It is the only local-government item in this ledger, and the fact that it sits in the responsible minister's own constituency is stated because it is the sort of thing a reader should be able to weigh.

summary: A [Kiswahili large language model](2026-07-24-tanzania-mafanikio-akili-unde-ai-waico-2026-shanghai) is described by the minister as a commitment written into the 2050 vision rather than something under construction.
developments:
The minister's text describes it as something the vision sets out, not something being built, and no held source connects a 61-million-word database to the model ([model](2026-07-24-tanzania-mafanikio-akili-unde-ai-waico-2026-shanghai), [achievements](2026-07-11-tanzania-yanadi-mafanikio-ya-matumizi-ya-akili-unde-katika-mageuzi-ya-kidijitali)).

University artificial-intelligence prototypes were shown at a national agricultural exhibition; they are student prototypes, self-reported, and admitted deliberately without a hub line ([prototypes](2026-08-04-ardhi-university-ai-counterfeit-drugs-financial-access)).

Reading a vision commitment as a build is the specific error this cell is written to avoid.

summary: A [ports authority enquiry chatbot](2026-08-03-tpa-faq-chatbot-tanzania-ports-authority) carries the only measured outcome attached to a public-sector artificial-intelligence deployment anywhere in this base.
developments:
It reaches the base through a design-and-evaluation study published in a peer-reviewed journal ([chatbot](2026-08-03-tpa-faq-chatbot-tanzania-ports-authority)).

Fifteen domain experts is a usability study rather than a deployment audit, which is why the measurement is worth recording and worth bounding in the same sentence.

summary: An [international acceleration centre](2026-04-02-tanzania-itu-innovation-center-launch) received final board approval two years after its host agreement, with no opening date attached.
developments:
Final approval came at an international innovation board meeting in April 2026; two years from host agreement to board approval with no opening date is the finding ([centre](2026-04-02-tanzania-itu-innovation-center-launch)).

One domestic company was named in a fifteen-startup accelerator cohort — the base's only named accelerator placement in the window ([placement](2026-04-21 Meet the 15 Startups Joining the Google for Startups Accelerator Africa Class 10)).

summary: The regulator put [digital clubs at 800](2026-08-04-tcra-ups-support-for-mathematics-digital-clubs) with no establishment dates, per-club spend, enrolment or outcome measure published, and [certified financial educators](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025) are counted with no prior-year figure.
developments:
The regulator anchors the clubs programme in the ten-year digital economy framework, and publishes nothing measurable about it ([clubs](2026-08-04-tcra-ups-support-for-mathematics-digital-clubs)).

Educators trained and individuals reached are recorded in an annual report with no prior-year figure held, so the count stands unbenchmarked ([educators](2026-07-23-tanzania-annual-financial-inclusion-report-2025)).

Eight hundred clubs and an unbenchmarked educator count are the two literacy measures in this unit, and neither can be read as a trend.

summary: A [school innovation lab](2026-08-24-airtel-fursa-lab-tanzania-digital-skills) opened at one secondary school, and a [science and ICT education grant](2022-01-01-koica-tza-science-ict-education-2022-project-to-strengthen-science-and-ict) of about US$10m runs to 2027 with no disbursement or school count held.
developments:
The lab was opened by an operator foundation and an incubator in August 2026; no funding figure, student number or programme length is stated, and one school is the whole of it ([lab](2026-08-24-airtel-fursa-lab-tanzania-digital-skills)).

The education grant is the only literacy-tagged commitment in the whole finance base, on a year-padded date with no disbursement, midline or school count ([grant](2022-01-01-koica-tza-science-ict-education-2022-project-to-strengthen-science-and-ict)).

summary: [Workforce training opened for 110 participants](2026-07-30-mwananchi-maeneo-manne-wataalamu-tehama-ictc) across four priority areas, and [sixteen graduates travelled](2026-03-16-serikali-kupeleka-wanafunzi-nje-kusomea-ai) on overseas artificial-intelligence scholarships with 34 more expected.
developments:
The workforce training opened in the commercial capital with European partners; no budget, duration, certification or repeat cadence is stated ([training](2026-07-30-mwananchi-maeneo-manne-wataalamu-tehama-ictc), [resilience](2026-07-29-tanzania-builds-cyber-resilience-ictc-eu-training)).

The education minister told a parliamentary committee that sixteen graduates had travelled and 34 were expected; no budget, selection criteria, bonding terms or return-placement plan is stated, and nothing later confirms the second cohort travelled ([scholarships](2026-03-16-serikali-kupeleka-wanafunzi-nje-kusomea-ai)).

An operator foundation expanded a digital skills programme for young people with no cohort size, curriculum, cost or completion figure published ([foundation](2026-08-26-airtel-africa-foundation-digital-skills-tanzania)).

summary: A [Zanzibar postgraduate technology campus](2026-07-05-zanzibar-positions-africas-technology-innovation-hub) held a second graduation of data-science, artificial-intelligence and ocean-structure cohorts, the only campus of its parent institution outside its home country.
developments:
Student and startup figures are institution-reported ([campus](2026-07-05-zanzibar-positions-africas-technology-innovation-hub)).

A three-year memorandum was signed for Zanzibar public-service artificial-intelligence and cybersecurity training, with no value, curriculum, certification or selection rule for the 600 stated ([memorandum](2026-08-17-tanzania-zanzibar-ai-cybersecurity-capacity-mou)).

A university information technology college building was inspected under construction by a parliamentary committee; its parent higher-education project is held nowhere in the base, neither as a source nor as a finance record ([building](2026-03-16-serikali-kupeleka-wanafunzi-nje-kusomea-ai)).

summary: The country was selected as the [sole national member of a global artificial-intelligence capacity development network](2026-08-22-thecitizen-tanzania-global-ai-capacity-network).
developments:
The selection was announced in August 2026 ([membership](2026-08-22-thecitizen-tanzania-global-ai-capacity-network)).

summary: The central bank [launched braille editions of its publications](2026-08-20-mwananchi-bot-braille-financial-publications) in August 2026.
developments:
No print run, distribution channel or digital-accessibility counterpart is published ([braille](2026-08-20-mwananchi-bot-braille-financial-publications)).

Braille editions of financial publications are the only disability-specific measure in this ledger, and the absence of a digital-accessibility counterpart is worth noting in a unit whose financial system is overwhelmingly mobile.

summary: A [digital transformation centre for rights and gender equity](2024-01-01-bmz-tza-001-digital-center-with-a-focus-on) carries a EUR 3,000,000 commitment for 2024 to 2027 — the only commitment in the whole finance base tagged to digital divides.
developments:
It is recorded in the compiled finance layer on a year-padded date, with no disbursement, outturn or beneficiary count held ([centre](2024-01-01-bmz-tza-001-digital-center-with-a-focus-on)).

That it is the only such commitment in the finance base is the finding, in a unit whose only measurement of online gendered violence is a civil-society researcher's own study.

summary: An [external fiscal transparency assessment](2026-08-11-state-gov-fiscal-transparency-report-2026-tanzania) found the country not meeting the minimum requirements in 2026.
developments:
It is an external assessment on a foreign government's own criteria, and it is the only recurring transparency measure the base holds for this country ([assessment](2026-08-11-state-gov-fiscal-transparency-report-2026-tanzania)).

No national open-data portal, catalogue or policy appears anywhere in this ledger, so a foreign assessment of fiscal transparency is doing the work an open-data indicator would otherwise do.

summary: An [educational cubesat](2026-04-30-kairuki-aomba-222-bilioni-bajeti-micit) appears as a line item in the ministry's 2026/27 budget request.
